usedFor: Slack holds the chat, and pushover alerts your devices when “Send a Pushover Notification” follows a Slack channel post.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Send a Pushover Notification” in pushover
bestTemplate.why: Messages from the channels you pick reach subscribed devices, so urgent ones do not wait in a tab.

watchOut: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” includes bot messages, so automated posts will notify your devices too.
